nodes.name: AboutUsStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the AboutUs page, defining a responsive 3-column grid layout for team section cards with paper-toned background and display typography.

nodes.name: AddLocationForm.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the AddLocationForm modal, styling a centered modal with form inputs, photo upload section with URL/file toggle, image preview, and action buttons.

nodes.name: AddUserForm.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the AddUserForm modal, styling a narrow centered modal with form inputs, required field indicators, and submit/cancel action buttons.

nodes.name: ContactFormStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the ContactForm, styling a full-page contact form with large display heading, responsive form layout, and submit button with hover states.

nodes.name: DestinationStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the Destination page, defining a multi-block layout with alternating image/text sections, decorative borders, and responsive grid breakpoints.

nodes.name: EditLocationForm.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the EditLocationForm modal, nearly identical to AddLocationForm, styling a centered modal with form inputs, photo upload section, and update/cancel buttons.

nodes.name: EditUserForm.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the EditUserForm modal, styling a narrow centered modal with form inputs, optional field indicators, password toggle section, and action buttons.

nodes.name: FooterStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the Footer component, styling a dark forest-toned footer with brand mark, social icons, and a 3-column link section layout.

nodes.name: HeroStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for Hero and HeroMid components, defining full-viewport hero sections with gradient overlays, decorative grid patterns, large display typography, and stats row.

nodes.name: ImageModalStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the ImageModal component, styling a fullscreen overlay with centered image display and close button positioned at top-right.

nodes.name: MountainCardStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for MountainCard component, styling a card with hover lift effect, image with zoom transition, difficulty badge, location icon, stats, and rating display.

nodes.name: MountainDetailsStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the MountainDetails page, defining a detailed mountain destination page with hero image overlay, content grid with info/review/weather panels, dossier, alternatives, and community sections.

nodes.name: NavbarStyles.css
nodes.summary: CSS stylesheet for the Navbar component, styling a sticky top navigation bar with brand mark, centered menu links, search bar with dropdown results, auth button, and mobile responsive breakpoints.
